name: Monthly Sample Movement Summary
query:
SELECT
	LEFT(smr.date_out, 7) as "Month:Data:90",
	smr.department as "Department:Link/Department:160",
	COUNT(*) as "Total Out:Int:90",
	SUM(CASE WHEN smr.status IN ('Out', 'Partially Returned', 'Overdue', 'Escalated') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Still Out:Int:90",
	SUM(CASE WHEN smr.status = 'Returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Returned:Int:90",
	SUM(CASE WHEN smr.status IN ('Overdue', 'Escalated') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Overdue / Escalated:Int:140",
	SUM(CASE WHEN smr.status = 'Written Off' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Written Off:Int:100",
	SUM(CASE WHEN smr.actual_return_date > smr.expected_return_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Returned Late:Int:110"
FROM `tabSample Movement Register` smr
WHERE smr.docstatus = 1 AND smr.status NOT IN ('Approved')
GROUP BY LEFT(smr.date_out, 7), smr.department
ORDER BY LEFT(smr.date_out, 7) DESC, smr.department
